# CANDIDATE: VIX_MEAN_REVERT_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Intraday VIX spikes above its 20-minute VWAP often revert, dragging SPY down; shorting on VIX mean-reversion captures the move. The edge exists because VIX tends to overextend short-term during panic spikes, creating a statistical reversion tendency that correlates with SPY downward moves.

## Mechanism

Entry: When VIX > VIX_20min_VWAP + 0.5 AND SPY makes a new 5-minute low AND RSI(14) < 45, enter short at the close of that 5-minute bar. Exit: Initial stop at recent swing high (prior LH/HL invalidation), TP1 at 1R (risk = entry - stop), runner trail using chandelier exit (ATR×3). Regime filter: Only trade when VIX between 18-25 and time between 10:00-12:00 ET; skip during FOMC windows.
